responsibility: Declares the vrange_printer visitor that formats GCC value ranges for pretty_printer output. It provides the public printing interface for irange, frange, and unsupported_range objects and encapsulates the helper routines needed to show integer bounds, nonzero masks, floating endpoints, and NaN state consistently in debug and dump output.
same_name_distinction: Declares the vrange_printer interface and helper method signatures, while the paired value-range-pretty-print.cc provides the actual formatting behavior. This header exists to expose the pretty-print visitor API to other GCC code without embedding the printing implementation.
